title: Stop records refusals as refusals, not served exposures
body:
Astra audit B2/B3 (verified): Stop logs refused records as served exposures with no task id and an empty withheld list (src/hook/stop.ts:1208-1211), so a refusal counts as an exposure; worker packets drop enforced records (src/brain/worker-packet.ts:68-73) and advisory checks return null (src/brain/standards-cli.ts:275-277), so exposure rows cannot compare served against withheld.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/brain/exposures.ts, test/hook/stop-exposure.test.ts
Outcome: Stop records refusals as refusals (not served exposures) with the claimed task id; exposure rows carry served and withheld ids; the test exits 0 and fails on the old logging.
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop-exposure.test.ts passes.
